title: Why is one side of your body stronger? 💪
caption:
Your brain is better at driving your dominant side, so it fires more muscle on that side. Train each side alone and the weak side catches up. Which side is your weak side? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #9
first_comment: Left side gang, where are you? 🫡
sources: Munn J, Herbert RD, Gandevia SC. Contralateral effects of unilateral resistance training: a meta-analysis. J Appl Physiol 2004;96:1861-1866 (untrained limb +7.8% strength)
Manca A et al. Cross-education of muscular strength following unilateral resistance training: a meta-analysis. Eur J Appl Physiol 2017;117:2335-2354
Carroll TJ et al. Contralateral effects of unilateral strength training: evidence and possible mechanisms. J Appl Physiol 2006;101:1514-1522
